{{Infobox auto|title=Prayer of Demeter|type=[[Blessing]]}}
The '''Prayer of Demeter''' is a [[blessing]], a crafted enchanted book that gives {{MCW|Frost Walker}} II and [[Frost Protection]] II. It is crafted from four golden apples, three blue ice and a golden hoe, and is the only craftable source of Frost Protection.

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
The book in the center must be a [[Hell-Bound Book]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blessing/frost_walker_frost_protection.json}}</ref> The crafted item is named "Blessing", with "Prayer of Demeter" as a dark gray lore line.

== Usage ==
The Prayer of Demeter is applied to equipment in an [[anvil]], like an {{MCW|Enchanted Book|enchanted book}}. Frost Walker applies to boots and Frost Protection to chestplates. Any level of Frost Protection on the chestplate protects from [[freezing water]], so this book is enough for that.

In 1.12.2 the book does not store Frost Protection itself but <code>main:freezing_protection</code>, the enchantment's id before the pack moved to the <code>matcha</code> namespace. Its tooltip line reads "ERROR: Please wear me to update II".<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/main/enchantment/freezing_protection.json}}</ref> The old enchantment applies to chestplates like Frost Protection and does nothing by itself, but each tick the chestplate is worn, one level of it is replaced with one level of Frost Protection, so two ticks after it is put on the chestplate has Frost Protection II.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/main/item_modifier/update_freezing_protection.json}}</ref>

== Trivia ==
* Demeter is the Greek goddess of the harvest; her grief for Persephone brings winter in the myth, matching the frost enchantments and the hoe in the recipe.
